Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one complete, premium native iOS visual design system concept board for Teto, an English-only dance social app. Landscape 3:2 composition at very high resolution, ideally 3840x2560. Flat front-facing UI artwork, no perspective phones, no hands holding phones. This is a polished professional design board for choosing a visual direction, not code or wireframes.
Layout: generous precise grid. Top header with "Teto" and the concept letter/title. Upper main region: six equal-width tall mobile page panels with readable short English labels, aligned baseline and balanced whitespace. Screens in order: Welcome/sign-in (dance-themed artwork, "Move with your people", "Get started", and a compact "One-tap sign in" + unchecked User Agreement block); Live/Shorts (immersive full-bleed photo of an adult dancer actually dancing, translucent floating controls, top Live / Shorts switch, search icon, author, bottom four tabs Live Voice Chats Me); Voice (dance party discovery, two-column room cards, style filters and search); Chats (dancer avatars, English dance conversations); Me (dancer profile, stats, dance works grid, prominent Wallet row); Wallet (Diamonds / Coins selector, balance, EXACT three-by-three tier grid with amount and price paired: 400 $0.99, 800 $1.99, 2,450 $4.99, 5,150 $9.99, 10,800 $19.99, 16,800 $29.99, 29,400 $49.99, 42,600 $69.99, 63,700 $99.99).
Lower region: a coherent reusable component library with clearly separated blocks. Buttons: primary "Follow", secondary "Message", icon-only search, disabled button, loading button, selected filter chip. Inputs: "Search dancers", "Say something", a checkbox and toggle. Navigation: 4 tabs Live / Voice / Chats / Me. Cards: compact creator card, audio room card, video tile, glass comment pill. Overlays: bottom sheet with colorful Rose / Balloons / Heart gifts priced 10 / 50 / 100 diamonds, small permission dialog. Background swatches: base page, elevated surface, dance-inspired abstract art backdrop, subtle video readability gradient. Palette row with 5 hex colors, font hierarchy sample "Dance your way" and "Find your rhythm". Exact short labels, highly legible typography. Prioritize clean believable UI and coherent reusable design, not visual clutter.
Adult dancers of varied genders and backgrounds, tasteful active dance clothing, studio / choreography / freestyle footage only. Do not use non-dance content, Chinese, other app brands, watermarks, Android UI, fabricated paid receipts, "demo", "sample" or "mockup" words in the board. No connected-call claims. Status bars are minimal plausible iOS system chrome. Match safe areas, readable text, realistic touch controls, rounded geometry appropriate for SwiftUI. Main navigation has four tabs only; Shorts stays inside Live. All board copy English. This is original Teto branding, not an imitation of a named app.
STYLE DIRECTION:
A / NEON STAGE. Cinematic midnight dance club, sophisticated not gamer. Board background charcoal #101018. UI backgrounds #11111D, elevated #222235, accent electric violet #A78BFA and hot pink #FF4D9D, mint detail #6EF3D6, main text white. Adult dancers in a real performance rehearsal with violet side-light. Translucent charcoal overlays, softly luminous primary buttons, precise hairline borders, minimal glow reserved for highlights. Rounded 22pt cards, pill follows, geometric clean sans serif. Rich purple/pink crystalline diamond and flower gift icons. Abstract background references a dancer's sweeping motion trails, with clear quiet text zones. All six screens dark theme, same grid and component layout. Print title "A / NEON STAGE".

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this Teto dance-social iOS design system board. Preserve exactly its composition, six screen panels, all adult dance photography, theme colors, concept letter and title, typography style, component grid, navigation and all other visual design. Only correct these app-specific details:
1) In the left welcome/sign-in screen remove the Apple, Google and email provider circles entirely. Replace that row with ONE full-width pill button labeled exactly "One-tap sign in", in the same style as the board. Keep "Get started" above it. The agreement checkbox beneath it must be EMPTY / unchecked. Keep concise "I agree to the User Agreement". Do not add other login providers or trademarks.
2) In the Wallet screen replace the large current balance (1,250 or 2,350) with exactly "0". Preserve all NINE amount/price tier pairs and the 3x3 grid: 400 $0.99; 800 $1.99; 2,450 $4.99; 5,150 $9.99; 10,800 $19.99; 16,800 $29.99; 29,400 $49.99; 42,600 $69.99; 63,700 $99.99. All wallet pack icons should be stylized DIAMONDS consistent with its theme, NOT flower or balloon gifts. If a purchase button exists use label "Recharge".
3) Lower component permission dialog: replace microphone icon with a CAMERA icon and exact short text "Allow camera access?" / "Your camera stays on this device." Buttons "Not now" and "Allow". Do not mention voice connections or microphone.
4) In the lower gift sheet ensure clean labels Rose, Balloons, Heart and exactly one diamond cost each: 10, 50, 100. Preserve gift artwork there.
All text English, no words such as demo, mockup, sample. Do not change the theme, add pages, remove components or modify unrelated art. Deliver one complete corrected board at the same aspect ratio, crisp and readable.
